question: Which of the following universities stood first at the Khelo India University Games-2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jain University**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Jain University** emerged as the top university at the **Khelo India University Games 2021**.
 
• The university secured the highest number of medals, including **20 gold, 7 silver, and 5 bronze**.
 
• The event was held in **Bengaluru, Karnataka**, with participation from over 200 universities across India.
 
• Khelo India University Games is an initiative by the Government of India to foster sporting talent at the university level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Programme**:

 
 
• Launched in 2018, the Khelo India programme aims to strengthen the sporting ecosystem in India.
 
• It includes components such as infrastructure development, talent identification, and financial assistance for athletes.
 
 
 
• **Objective of Khelo India University Games**:
 
 
• The primary aim is to identify and nurture talent from universities across India.
 
• It provides a platform for university athletes to showcase their skills on a national stage.
 
 
 
• **Previous Winners**:
 
 
• The first edition of Khelo India University Games was held in 2020, with Panjab University emerging as the top university.
 
 
 
• **Sports Included**:
 
 
• The games cover a wide range of sports, including athletics, badminton, basketball, boxing, football, hockey, swimming, and more.
